messages:
Asha (CS Ops): Quick sync request — our playbook triggers are missing a lot of events because external telemetry ids aren't mapped into Account.external_ids. Can we backfill telemetry_id -> external_ids and add an on-write hook so playbooks match correctly?

Liam: Yep. Which cohorts are high priority?

Asha (CS Ops): trial->paid, onboarding-in-flight, enterprise-eval. Backfill cutoff: telemetry_last_seen > 2025-01-01 to avoid ancient noise.

Riley: Will do staged approach. Snapshot before any write. Proposed SQL for a temp column then swap: 
```
UPDATE accounts a
SET external_ids_tmp = array_union(coalesce(a.external_ids_tmp, '{}'), t.telem_id)
FROM telemetry_ids t
WHERE t.account_id = a.id AND t.last_seen > '2025-01-01';
```
Then run diffs and swap.

Nico: Playbook matcher also needs to prefer external_ids over primary_email to avoid duplicates on shared emails. I'll add a config flag. Also we should include source in webhook payload so we know it's telemetry-derived.

Asha (CS Ops): Minimal webhook we need: account_id, external_ids, csat_score, event_ts, optional source="telemetry".

Liam: Can we debounce/dedupe webhooks? Mobile SDK retries created duplicates last month.

Riley: Yes 5s dedupe window in the lambda, we usually set 10m for these event types. Also rate-limit staging queue to 1000/min for the backfill run.

Nico: Plan: 1) run backfill on staging tonight, 2) deploy matcher change to staging, 3) smoke tests and metric diffs, 4) prod backfill + deploy. I'll own the matcher + lambda debounce.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued for 2026-02-15 02:00 UTC by Nico. :gear:

Asha (CS Ops): I'll verify counts and share a short report (pre/post). Can someone post sample rows and counts after staging run? :eyes:

Nico: Running now on staging, will post counts in this thread when finished.

Liam: Also add a weekly metric card "Accounts with external_ids linked" to CS ops dashboard so we can track coverage over time.

Asha (CS Ops): Adding to this week's ops deck and agenda. After staging looks good I'll open the prod backfill ticket and tag owners. :thumbsup:
